summary: Operator site: confirmed $50 daily (any lot, electric included, plus tax). Added 50-amp full hookups, 36 back-in RV sites (+8 MH spaces), showers/laundry/Wi-Fi, year-round, reservations by phone/contact form. Note: dropped the rate and RV Life lines (now in fees/rating). Not stated: max rig length.
flags: Price gate: base $50/night plus tax (electric included) on the operator's site, right at the US$50 line; no gateway within 40 km (nearest Walt Disney World 71 km, Orlando 78 km). The family has not stayed here.
55+ community ('55+ Community With the exception of traveling nurses, active military, or police').

Long-stay test 5: 36 RV sites against 8 mobile home spaces, so RV sites outnumber homes; no homes or lots for sale on the site (MH spaces and annual sites are rented). Daily nights are sold at the same $50 year-round, but the site markets mostly to snowbirds, full-timers and annual residents (annual site rates, credit/background checks for 6+ months).

Waterfront re-audit lead: the operator says the park sits 'on the canal to spring-fed Lake Panasoffkee' with a fishing dock ('Our canal opens straight onto 5,000-acre, spring-fed Lake Panasoffkee'); the entry is 'not waterfront'.
